_meta.purpose: ECOCROP-style environmental min-opt-max per crop for deterministic suitability scoring (§C.9 ranking.engine).
_meta.status: ECOCROP lookup done (data/raw/fao_ecocrop/rice.json) — ranges are a real read, not placeholders. aman_rice/boro_rice/aus_rice share identical values because ECOCROP is species-level (Oryza sativa), not season-level; each still carries `_verify: true` pending a human confirming the derivation before demo.

boro_rice._note: ECOCROP (data/raw/fao_ecocrop/rice.json) is a single species-level Oryza sativa record — it cannot distinguish Boro/Aus/Aman, so this is deliberately identical to aman_rice's range. Season differentiation happens via season_fit (crop_rules.json's `season` field), not here — this is a known FAO ECOCROP limitation, not an oversight.

aus_rice._note: Same species-level ECOCROP limitation as boro_rice above — identical range to aman_rice/boro_rice by construction, not an oversight.
